The existing close timer and certificate-exception separation are linked to prior focused claims. Accepted source has later NNTP support, error-category/l10n changes, confirmation dialog and Exchange outgoing API; these are not outcomes introduced by this patch.",
        "Direct newly enabled/added EWS tests expect success, test.test:443 and View Certificate visibility through fetchCert/checkStatus/checkButtons. They do not exercise a bad redirected EWS URL or authenticated EWS request. The four current checkButtons Assert.equal calls at679–694 lack message arguments; report this scoped helper diagnostic gap. Surrounding status assertions have non-empty expected-behavior messages. No test was run.",
        "The accepted component type JSDoc lists imap/pop3/smtp/nntp but omits the implemented ews case. The handler reads securityInfo.serverCert without a null guard; the happy-path EWS test does not prove behavior for every network failure. No failure is asserted solely from that static absence.",
        "Complete retained Bug1986415 comments0–4 and D263682 creation-to-final timeline plus actual inlines1443831/1443763 read. The reviewer explicitly parks use of the full stored EWS URL for redirect-certificate cases; this is not adopted by the host-root GET. The mail-pref prefix request is adopted in the exact landed and accepted source. Approval and historical completed build markers add no fresh EWS/TLS execution. Four existing checkButtons assertions in the affected helper scope omit messages; the EWS branch is absent from the current type JSDoc. These findings are preserved as scoped source evidence."
